        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.copy_floor = Object("copy_floor", self.Location)
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.charging_station = Object("charging_station", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_supplies = Object("cleaning_supplies", self.ObjectType)
        self.equipment_checklist = Object("equipment_checklist", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.robot_active = Fluent("robot_active", BoolType())
        self.cleaning_complete = Fluent("cleaning_complete", BoolType())
        self.equipment_checked = Fluent("equipment_checked", BoolType())
        self.maintenance_complete = Fluent("maintenance_complete", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_copy_center = Fluent("setting_is_copy_center", BoolType())
        self.area_is_high_traffic = Fluent("area_is_high_traffic", BoolType())
        self.operational_hours = Fluent("operational_hours", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_scheduling = Fluent("robot_has_scheduling", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.robot_active, self.cleaning_complete, self.equipment_checked, self.maintenance_complete]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_copy_center, self.area_is_high_traffic, self.operational_hours, self.robot_has_scheduling]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.copy_floor, self.storage_area, self.charging_station, self.cleaning_supplies, self.equipment_checklist]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.copy_floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.copy_floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.copy_floor), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_charging = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_charging")
        navigate_to_charging.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.charging_station)))
        navigate_to_charging.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.copy_floor), False)
        navigate_to_charging.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_charging.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), True)

        # Perform cleaning action - robot cleans the copy center
        perform_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("perform_cleaning")
        perform_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.copy_floor))
        perform_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_active)
        perform_cleaning.add_precondition(Not(self.cleaning_complete))
        perform_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_complete, True)

        # Check equipment action - robot performs equipment checks
        check_equipment = InstantaneousAction("check_equipment")
        check_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.copy_floor))
        check_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_active)
        check_equipment.add_precondition(Not(self.equipment_checked))
        check_equipment.add_effect(self.equipment_checked, True)

        # Enter standby mode action - robot shuts down or enters low-power mode
        enter_standby = InstantaneousAction("enter_standby")
        enter_standby.add_precondition(self.robot_active)
        enter_standby.add_precondition(self.cleaning_complete)
        enter_standby.add_precondition(self.equipment_checked)
        enter_standby.add_effect(self.robot_active, False)
        enter_standby.add_effect(self.maintenance_complete, True)

        # Activate robot action - robot wakes up from standby
        activate_robot = InstantaneousAction("activate_robot")
        activate_robot.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_active))
        activate_robot.add_effect(self.robot_active, True)

        return navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_charging, perform_cleaning, check_equipment, enter_standby, activate_robot

        dangerous_actions = {

                self.robot_at(self.copy_floor),  # Robot is on the copy center floor
                self.area_is_high_traffic,  # Area is high traffic
                self.operational_hours  # During operational hours
            ]),  # Entering standby on the floor during busy hours is dangerous

        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====

        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.copy_floor), True)  # Robot starts on copy floor
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_active, True)  # Robot is initially active
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_complete, False)  # Cleaning not done
